subtopics: Best practices for preserving named entities, terminology, and numbers in localized output: guidance from localization industry bodies (GALA, TAUS, CSA Research, ISO 17100)

Localization quality assurance workflows: automated QA checks for tag mismatch and number mismatch, LQA review, and regression testing of localized builds
